overview: Mukhyamantri Swarozgar Yojana (MSY) is a state-level scheme in Uttarakhand aimed at generating maximum employment and subsidiary employment by providing loan facilities through nationalized/scheduled commercial banks, state cooperative banks, and regional rural banks for setting up enterprises, services, or businesses. It targets enterprising youth, returning migrants due to Covid-19, skilled/unskilled artisans, handicraftsmen, and educated urban/rural unemployed individuals. The scheme operates under guiding principles to encourage self-employment and industrial/business establishment in the state.
objectives: Generate maximum employment and subsidiary employment
Link beneficiaries to enterprise, service, or business setup
Provide loan facility through nationalized/scheduled commercial banks
Provide loan facility through state cooperative banks/regional rural banks
Encourage enterprising youth of the state
Support migrants of Uttarakhand who returned due to Covid-19
Assist skilled and unskilled artisans and handicraftsmen
Aid educated urban and rural unemployed individuals
eligibility: Enterprising youth of the state, migrants of Uttarakhand who have returned due to Covid-19, skilled and unskilled artisans and handicraftsmen, and educated urban and rural unemployed individuals are eligible to establish their own industries/businesses under Mukhyamantri Swarozgar Yojana.
benefits: Loan facility through nationalized/scheduled commercial banks, state cooperative banks, and regional rural banks for setting up enterprise, service, or business; support for establishing own industries/businesses; encouragement of self-employment and entrepreneurship in Uttarakhand.
financial_support: The scheme provides loan facility through nationalized/scheduled commercial banks, state cooperative banks, and regional rural banks for setting up enterprise, service, or business. Specific quantum, interest rates, or repayment terms are not detailed in the evidence.
application_process: The evidence does not provide a numbered step-by-step application procedure for Mukhyamantri Swarozgar Yojana.
